property_summary: After lockInGuess, settle() must revert while the current block number is still <= the stored target block (the guess cannot be settled in the same block it targets); the mutant's non-strict check lets settle() succeed at block.number == target, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Change the time check from strict inequality to non-strict inequality, allowing settle() to succeed in the same block the guess targets.
